📸 Text me a photo of the VIN

The VIN tells me exactly which glass your vehicle takes. Snap a photo of it and text it to me.

Can't find your VIN?
  • 1

    Driver's side dashboard 👀

    A metal plate at the base of the Wind Shield. Stand outside on the driver's side and read it through the Wind Shield.

  • 2

    Driver's door jamb 👀

    Open the driver's door — the VIN is on the sticker on the door frame / post.

  • 3

    Your paperwork 👀

    It's also printed on your insurance card, vehicle registration, and title — a photo of any of those works too.

🚗✨ For fleets & shops

Tire shops, auto body shops, tow yards, and fleet operators: when a vehicle on your lot needs glass, you don't need a 1-800 number — you need a person who picks up.

Make me your glass contact. One call or text and any vehicle in your yard gets its glass handled — back on the road, off your lot.

Register your fleet once — the Wind Shield part for every vehicle goes on file with us. When a window breaks, one click tells us which vehicle needs it: we already hold the part, we already know the quotes, and we know who's got the best deal. Everything's set to go.
